source: The objects Windows keeps that a responder looks a host up by, named as the Windows documentation names them (mutex objects, files and directories, registry keys and values, Task Scheduler tasks, services, named pipes, NTFS alternate data streams). Written for this project, not copied from a third-party table.
about: The closed vocabulary the report model types each host identifier with, and what the platform's IOC table makes of each. 'table_kind' is the row kind the IOC table and /iocs carry an exported value under (empty: the kind is never exported); 'label' is the row's type as the table prints it; 'shape' says how the value is read: a whole 'name', a 'path' (a file path, which must name a file), a 'file_name' (a file's own name, read without the separators written before it), a 'folder' (a folder's name or path), a 'key' (a registry key or value path). 'words' is how the instruction to the report model describes the kind. A row whose kind is not one of these words (a free-text kind, as reports stored before this vocabulary write) is read and printed as written and never exported. 'uses' is what the model says the evidence shows the sample doing with the value; only 'creates/writes' is exported.

file path.label: File path
file path.words: a file's path, with its folder

file name.label: File name
file name.words: a file's own name, without a folder

registry value.label: Registry value
registry value.words: a registry value, written under its key

scheduled task.label: Scheduled task
scheduled task.words: the name of a scheduled task

named pipe.label: Named pipe
named pipe.words: the name of a named pipe

alternate data stream.label: Alternate data stream
alternate data stream.words: the name of an NTFS alternate data stream

string.words: any other value, or one whose entry does not show what it is

template.words: a format string the code fills in (it holds a placeholder such as %s or %x)

uses.creates/writes: the evidence shows the sample creating or writing it
uses.reads/checks: the evidence shows the sample only reading or checking it
uses.not shown: the evidence does not show what the sample does with it
